notes.title: Escape!! - Date Night
notes.content:
Date Night is a large update that adds a new chaser zombie, two unique songs for each siesta, a new DLC outfit, and several quality of life changes.

List of Changes

Added a new Zombie chaser that alternates with the original Freak for Sally's attention.
Added a new DLC Outfit for Sally: Date Night.
Added two unique songs for each Siesta activity.
Tweaked sprite data to make the run and kick a little smoother.
Adjusted the back button in the Siesta areas to stay longer and fade slower, for a more comfortable experience.
Tweaked the hitboxes of the flying Lungefreaks and Hazard 4 to be more accurate and forgiving.
Regulated the music volumes, hopefully making less of a range between the loudest and quietest songs.

notes.title: Escape!! v1.02 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:

 Added copyright to the options screen.
